project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.
project.context: This finding comes from a scan of the cavet repository itself.

finding.description:
engine/Dockerfile:65
'RUN cd ...' to change directory
verdict: dismissed (high confidence, by operator): cd /src at engine/Dockerfile:43 is chained inside a single RUN whose entire body operates under /src; the gitleaks-build stage contains no later RUN that could assume a persisted working directory, so the hazard DS-0013 flags does not arise (same shape in trivy-build)

mechanical_context.path_class: container image build definition (shipped as the scanner engine image)
mechanical_context.source_excerpt:
37 | # tag plus go's own module-hash verification (checksum db) cover provenance.
   38 | # gore2regex + CGO_ENABLED=0 mirror the upstream release build (go-re2 is
   39 | # pure-Go wazero, no cgo needed); -ldflags injects the version so
   40 | # `gitleaks --version` still reports the tag.
   41 | FROM golang:1.26-bookworm@sha256:9fdc884aacc3bec89b20ffc69f4bb369c78210e3e4f600387b5128b12c199f81 AS gitleaks-build
   42 | ARG GITLEAKS_VERSION
   43 | RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch "v${GITLEAKS_VERSION}" https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks /src \
   44 |     && cd /src \
   45 |     && go get golang.org/x/crypto@latest golang.org/x/net@latest \
   46 |     && go mod tidy \
   47 |     && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -tags gore2regex -trimpath \
   48 |         -ldflags "-s -w -X=github.com/zricethezav/gitleaks/v8/version.Version=${GITLEAKS_VERSION}" \
   49 |         -o /out/gitleaks .
